title: Landscape Construction: General Practices
description: General practices of construction as applied to landscape projects. Basic tools and equipment, building materials and hardware, and installation techniques utilized in landscape construction. Focus is on hardscape applications, including paving, walls, masonry, decks, and related wood structures. Review of safety practices, careers in landscape construction, and contractor licensing.
outcomes: Correctly identify tools used in landscape construction.
Demonstrate, on manipulative examinations, the implementation of basic landscape construction projects using a variety of building materials and hardware.
objectives: List career opportunities in landscape construction.
Identify and use tools and equipment utilized in landscape construction.
Identify and select the proper landscape materials to complete an installation.
Complete the implementation of basic landscape construction projects using a variety of building materials and hardware.
Explain landscape construction safety practices and apply the correct use of safety equipment to projects.
Demonstrate knowledge of the contractor licensing process.
content: Career opportunities in landscape construction industry
Fasteners, connectors, and other structural materials
Professional associations related to landscape contraction
lab: Safety practices lab: With the instructor, students review the individual tools and their safe handling and operation.
Tool lab: Students actively use a variety of landscape construction tools in typical landscape applications.
Deck lab: Working in groups, students build a small wood deck from the ground up.
Concrete and masonry labs: Students pour concrete paving, build masonry walls, and install unit pavers and flagstone.

Landscape materials lab: Students visit one or more landscape suppliers to gain an understanding of what materials are available for use in landscape construction, and how to manage and order the materials.
